summary.text: Paul Cameron is the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 95 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ty Moore.
He is a retired U.S. Army veteran and construction manager from Belmont County.

paragraphs.text: Cameron served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2014, according to Ballotpedia, and holds associate degrees from Cochise College (1999) and Belmont College (2012) and a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona (2003).

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is an activist and organizer who works with Belmont County Unify and Ohio Valley Mutual Aid, a Scout leader, and previously worked as a mail carrier, census worker and field surveyor.
He said he would focus on community revitalization, using funding to restore downtown buildings in small towns and to place locally owned businesses in them.
